Hi Samira —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery: Acme AI is evaluating an inference platform to reduce per-token cost and get predictable latency for your customer-facing agents. Key themes we heard:

- Primary goal: reduce 95th percentile latency for chat endpoints from ~750ms to under 300ms for typical sessions.
- Data/security: SOC 2 + customer-managed KMS is required for production.
- Volume profile: bursty traffic with daily peaks around 10am PT and 4pm PT.

Next steps I suggested: a 45-minute demo + technical deep dive where we show the runtime, batching behavior, and security controls. Michael (CC'd) would join to cover infra sizing; Evelyn can cover enterprise/security questions.

Are you available for one of these slots next week?
- Wed 7/22 9:00–9:45am PT
- Wed 7/22 1:00–1:45pm PT
- Thu 7/23 10:00–10:45am PT

I've attached a short agenda. If none of those work, please suggest two windows and I will lock in with a calendar invite. Would you prefer us to include your procurement or infra leads on the initial invite?

Thanks, and apologies if you were pulled away earlier — happy to be flexible.
